name: anaglyph-look
description: A dark theme with a 3D scene behind the chat for red-cyan glasses: an arena of tanks and beacons that follows what Claude is doing, or a grid with floating shapes, and a calibration step that tunes the colors to your glasses.

scene.title: Scene
scene.description: arena: tanks drive while Claude works, fire when a tool runs, and beacons light up when Claude is waiting for you. grid: a floor rolling toward you with wireframe shapes floating in and out of the screen.

depth.title: Depth
depth.description: How far the scene reaches behind and in front of the screen. 1 is the default; lower it if lines stay doubled, raise it if the scene looks flat.

glasses.title: Glasses
glasses.description: How much of the wrong color your lenses let through, until you calibrate: clean for glass or good acrylic lenses, typical for most plastic pairs, leaky for cardboard ones. /anaglyph-calibrate tunes it to your own pair.
